summary: Tested Missing Booking Details Notification feature for iCal imports. All 14 backend tests PASSED. All frontend UI components verified working. Fixed 1 bug during testing: auto-resolve notifications regardless of read status.
passed_tests: Backend: test_01_notifications_empty_initially - GET /api/notifications returns empty list for new company
Backend: test_02_unread_count_zero_initially - GET /api/notifications/unread-count returns 0
Backend: test_03_create_incomplete_booking - Create booking with is_data_complete=false
Backend: test_04_incomplete_only_filter - GET /api/bookings?incomplete_only=true returns only incomplete bookings
Backend: test_05_trigger_notification_creation - Updating incomplete booking creates notification
Backend: test_06_unread_count_updated - Unread count increases when notification created
Backend: test_07_mark_single_read - PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read marks notification as read
Backend: test_08_mark_all_read - PUT /api/notifications/read-all marks all notifications as read
Backend: test_09_complete_booking_updates_is_data_complete - Adding guest_name and total_amount sets is_data_complete=true
Backend: test_10_incomplete_bookings_empty_after_completion - No incomplete bookings after all completed
Backend: test_11_notification_auto_resolved - Notification auto-resolved when all bookings complete
Backend: test_12_mark_nonexistent_notification - PUT /api/notifications/{invalid_id}/read returns 404
Backend: test_13_booking_incomplete_without_guest_name - Booking without guest_name is incomplete
Backend: test_14_booking_incomplete_without_amount - Booking without total_amount is incomplete
Frontend: Dashboard shows notification bell icon with unread badge when notifications exist
Frontend: Notification dropdown shows 'Missing Booking Details' notification with 'Review Bookings' link
Frontend: Clicking notification navigates to /bookings?filter=incomplete
Frontend: Bookings page auto-switches to list view when incomplete filter is active
Frontend: Incomplete filter button shows amber/yellow active state
Frontend: Incomplete booking rows have yellow highlight (bg-amber-50)
Frontend: Warning icons (AlertTriangle) appear on incomplete booking rows
Frontend: 'Guest name required' and 'Amount required' messages show on incomplete bookings
Frontend: Edit booking dialog allows adding missing guest_name and total_amount
Frontend: Completing booking removes warning icon and yellow highlight
Frontend: Notification badge disappears after all bookings completed (auto-resolved)
Frontend: Revenue KPIs exclude incomplete bookings, include completed ones ($0 -> $750)

notification_endpoints.details: GET /api/notifications, GET /api/notifications/unread-count, PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read, PUT /api/notifications/read-all all working correctly

incomplete_bookings_filter.details: GET /api/bookings?incomplete_only=true returns only bookings with is_data_complete=false

is_data_complete_recalculation.details: PUT /api/bookings/{id} recalculates is_data_complete based on guest_name and total_amount presence

notification_auto_resolve.details: When all incomplete bookings are completed, notification is auto-resolved and marked as read

frontend_notification_bell.details: Bell icon in Layout header shows unread badge, dropdown with notifications, 'Review Bookings' link

frontend_incomplete_filter.details: Incomplete button toggles filter, URL param ?filter=incomplete activates it and switches to list view

frontend_incomplete_indicators.details: Yellow highlight on rows, warning icons, 'Guest name required'/'Amount required' messages

incomplete_excluded_from_kpis.details: Revenue MTD shows $0 for incomplete booking, updates to $750 after completing

bug_fixed_during_testing.issue: Notification auto-resolve only worked for unread notifications
bug_fixed_during_testing.fix: Changed query from {read: False} to {resolved: {$ne: True}} in check_and_create_incomplete_notification

test_credentials.note: Tests create their own test users/sessions with timestamps for isolation

seed_data_creation: Test creates temporary test users, properties, bookings, and notifications - cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Missing Booking Details Notification feature fully verified. Backend APIs: GET /api/notifications, GET /api/notifications/unread-count, PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read, PUT /api/notifications/read-all. Incomplete bookings filter via GET /api/bookings?incomplete_only=true. is_data_complete auto-calculated on booking update. Frontend: notification bell in Layout header, incomplete filter button on Bookings page, warning icons and yellow highlights for incomplete rows. Revenue KPIs exclude incomplete bookings. Migration ran on startup and sets is_data_complete for existing bookings.
